info.name: VaachakAI Classroom API
info.description: All 100 classroom API operations. Set base_url, name, email, password and role; run Register or Login to save token automatically. Authenticated requests inherit Bearer {{token}}. Switch credentials and log in again for teacher vs learner actions. Creation requests save resource IDs. Empty ID variables must be populated before use. Select local files for uploads. This is an endpoint reference, not an ordered collection-runner workflow; choose requests individually, especially deletion/logout. API docs: {{base_url}}/api/docs. Supabase deployment-generated endpoints are separate and are not part of this collection.

Scheduling is Leitner: a task returns after 1, 2, 4, 8 then 16 days, moving up a box each
time it is answered well and dropping back to the first box when it is not. A task that
survives the longest gap is treated as learned and stops appearing.
